newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 3. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 3. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Late French president Francois Mitterrand had allegedly ordered phone tapping from the Elysee presidential palace.
-- Eurotunnel to modify safety rules for trains carrying lorries following internal inquiry into November 1996 fire in the Anglo-French Channel Tunnel.
-- Lagardere group posts profit of more than one billion francs for 1996
-- Coal mining firm Charbonnages de France chairman Philippe de Ladoucette says in an interview seeks to diversify in electricity market ahead of a shut-down of mining activity scheduled for 2005.
